name: Coprates Drill

profiles.name: Drill
profiles.behavior: Explicit movement drills; fire only inside the commanded range after actual stopped motion and confirmed public target lock.

profiles.name: Guard
profiles.behavior: Same drill contract with stricter odds, shorter observed target range, fresher plots, narrower screen, earlier health withdrawal and more retained ammunition.

authoring_choices: Drill/Guard names, values and stationary firing policy are provisional content defaults, not faction policy. No order or Hold clears and stops; Advance and Support never fire. Disabling motion or requesting a lock is not evidence of an already stopped/locked view.
authority: No Territorial Force organization, Republic identity, standing rule, availability check, account, title, filing, listing, licence, certificate or activation.
integration_required: actual scoped house publisher and paid filing
separately selected current Republic-standing eligibility rule
ordinary licensed distribution with current transaction checks
